improvedVsOld: The new text is clearly better than the old in almost every unit. It uses the je-form consistently and has a shorter Dutch sentence rhythm. Glossary terms are fixed: freedom camping instead of 'vrij kamperen', self-contained instead of 'zelfvoorzienend', lozingspunt (dump station) instead of 'stortplaatsen', app list names ('Vond ik leuk', 'Wil bezoeken', 'Pinnen', 'Allemaal opgeslagen') instead of 'Leuk'/'Punaises'. Speeds are written km/u, prices NZ$ 110 tot 180. The banned 'offline kampeerkaart' keyword and 'ver buiten het netwerk' are gone. The style-guide examples (heroTitle, the DOC stiltetijden heading, the quiet-location sentence) are applied verbatim. It restores the tank-assumption sentence (11 l fresh, 9 l grey water) that the old calculatorNote had dropped. Titles and meta descriptions now lead with Dutch search terms. All six rewritten articles plus support and terms keep the same structure as the English. There are no em dashes, no u/uw, no bare $ amounts, macrons are intact (hapū, Māori) and there are no offline-map claims ('plekgegevens offline' / 'ook zonder bereik' only). Facts, numbers and dates match the English apart from the privacy issues listed under critical. Only one unit got worse: doc-huts sections[1].body[1], 'Pak in op'. Minor: ui.metaTitle (~74 chars) and ui.metaDescription run past the 60/155 targets. The ones listed as failing are the only units below 4.
criticalIssues: Privacy page is structurally out of step with origin/main en.json. EN has 7 sections, with a new 'Website analytics' GA4/cookie section at index 4; NL has 6. lib/localized.ts isPageComplete() rejects it, so all 12 rewritten privacy units never render and Dutch visitors get the English page. The Dutch text also lacks the GA4 disclosure, which matters for EU (NL/BE) readers now that GA4 is live. Add the translated analytics section at index 4 and set effective to 'Geldig vanaf 19 oktober 2026' before merging.

nl.json has no 'consent' block, which origin/main added: Privacy choices, the banner text, Accept/Decline. The cookie bar falls back to English on /nl pages. It does not block publishing, but it should be translated in the same pass as the privacy section, e.g. label 'Privacykeuzes', accept 'Accepteren', decline 'Weigeren', policy 'Privacybeleid'.

failingUnits.current: 6 sections: ... [3] Externe links en websitelogs, [4] Bewaren en zelf beheren, [5] Kinderen en contact
failingUnits.problem: origin/main en.json now has 7 privacy sections: 'Website analytics' (4 paragraphs on GA4, the _ga cookies, consent, 14-month retention) was added at index 4 after this branch was cut. The NL file still has 6. By JSON path, NL 'Bewaren en zelf beheren' sits under EN 'Website analytics', and NL 'Kinderen en contact' sits under EN 'Retention and control'. isPageComplete() in lib/localized.ts requires the same section count, so the whole rewritten Dutch privacy page is thrown away and English is served. Even if it were served, the GA4 disclosure would be missing.

Keep the existing 'Bewaren en zelf beheren' and 'Kinderen en contact' sections as sections 5 and 6.
